photo.description: Authentic Toyota GR Supra promotional photograph, black car with red mirrors driving toward the camera through a desert canyon. No baked-in text.
photo.crop: Centered car spans approximately 30%-73% of image width; use object-position: 51% 50%. At landscape half-screen ratios near 1:1, front fascia remains visible.

logo.source: Inline header SVG from the official Toyota site, 142 by 32 viewBox. Red square Toyota emblem and black TOYOTA wordmark. Standard SVG namespace corrected from https to http; paths unchanged.

reuse.status: No open license. Toyota terms limit site/download reuse to personal noncommercial use and require written consent for other use. User should supply their authorized Toyota brand assets or ensure permission before commercial deployment.
